factors.name: llm_downside_risk_adjusted_momentum_e7c610de
factors.economic_logic: Rewarding momentum while penalizing downside volatility isolates quality trend signals from speculative high-beta noise.

proposal_metadata.hypothesis: ETFs with strong short-term momentum and lower downside risk yield higher cross-sectional excess returns over 20 days.
failure_modes: Extreme momentum crashes where historically low downside volatility rapidly spikes.
Broad market panic selling where downside volatility dominates cross-sectional variance.
